new_part_types.name: Plate 1x2 with hole end (teal, headlight housing)
Wing mirror on pin base (light grey)
Plate 1x1 with curved bumper end (light grey)

notes: Part types use the Element IDs printed in the manual's inventory pages (59-60). lego-9551 (steering wheel on plate) and lego-9339 (black minifig legs) are printed as 9551 and 9339 on page 59, and both already exist in the provided catalogue under those ids, so I kept them. They are older short design numbers, not typos.
IDs missing from the catalogue were added as new types; existing catalogue types were reused where the ID matched.

Port names are left null on stud/anti-stud, side-hole, hinge-to-clip and minifig joins. One catalogue port stands for a whole array of studs, so naming it would reuse a single-use port many times. Some of those joins also have no valid port pair in the allowed list (stud into side hole, hinge finger onto clip, minifig neck/hip, tyre onto rim). Ports are kept only where unique and compatible: pins into pin-holes, mirror bar into clip, rim axle-hole onto axle.
Catalogue entry lego-614126 is labelled 'Wheel' but the manual shows it as a 1x1 round plate (7x), so it is used as a round plate.
The car is built from the rear (licence plate end) first; the front bumper, grille and headlights come in steps 33-35.

The pictures are small, so which stud or plate a piece sits on is partly inferred. Attachments of the tail fins, side brackets, doors, bumper caps and front deck parts are best guesses at the nearest plausible parent.
The six side brackets with teal slopes (step 19) are attached to the chassis plates with overrides; the true layout is three per side.

Mirrored pairs (bumper caps steps 14/15, tail fins 17/18) are repeats with a mirror override. The doors (steps 29/30) are individual parts so the side trim and mirrors can reference them. Sticker 1 (AM 0937) is on the rear tile and the front bumper arch; stickers are not nodes.

Minifigure assembly is on page 8. Man: black/grey hair, glasses head, blue letter jacket, black legs. Woman: blonde hair, sunglasses head, black jacket, purple legs. Which of heads 6103171/6112623 goes with which figure is assumed. Both figures sit on the seat jumper plates in step 39.
The tail-light tubes slide over the pins fitted in the grey 1x1 bricks in step 13. The headlight pins hold the clear lens plates. The wing mirrors clip into the door clips.
